posts.author: starguy
posts.body:
Hey all!
I've been looking for a plugin that replaces the 'Attack' command with a new one, like 'Limit' (which activates a specified skill) when the TP gauge is filled, akin to FF7's Limit Break system. On the forum here it looks like the only option for MZ for that is
Victor's Command Replace
plugin, which does the trick for MZ even though it's an MV plugin, so that's cool. However I'm getting some incompatibility with another essential plugin for me,
NRP_DynamicMotionMZ
where I get an error saying "cannot read property 'setDynamicMotion' of undefined." I understand that means that setDynamicMotion is seemingly a property of some undefined thing, which is only because of the
Victor's Basic Module
which is required for the Command Replace plugin. So I THINK the issue is with
NRP_DynamicMotionMZ
and
Victor's Basic Module
.
I'm wondering if anyone would be will to take a look and see what the issue between them is, and if possible, whip up a patch plugin for it?
If so, I'd be much appreciated! Thanks!
